profile.name: Pravesh Bahadur Shahi
profile.title: Bsc.IT student and Mobile Application Developer
profile.summary: I am a BSc.IT 6th-semester student at Techspire College, affiliated with Asia Pacific University, and an aspiring mobile application developer with hands-on experience in mobile application development, web technologies, databases, and software development. I enjoy building practical, user-focused mobile applications using React Native, Node.js, XAMPP, and MySQL. During my studies I have built a personalized mental-health mobile application, an e-commerce system, an HRM system, a food delivery application, a voting system, and database-driven applications, using JavaScript, Python, Java, C, HTML, CSS, SQL, and Figma.
profile.goal: I am looking for an opportunity to begin my professional career as a Mobile Application Developer / React Native Developer, where I can apply my skills, keep learning, and contribute to real-world software projects.
